name: Irene
self_text: I am Irene, a non-binary Australian in my late 30s. Outside of gaming, I enjoy urban gardening because I love seeing things grow in the city. I play on PC. I play Hollow Lantern in ranked matches. I am available on Saturday afternoons or weekday evenings. For communication, I use text chat or voice chat only.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into Tidewatch. It'd be a small bonus if you are available Saturday afternoon or weekday evenings, but no big deal.
